answer: Require each agent to hold a bonded stake in a shared atlas registry and emit a periodic verifiable pulse proving continuous useful work, not just a login. A new identity starts hollow, with no reputation, rate limits, and no rewards until its pulse history and completed attestations accumulate over time. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real stake per identity plus sustained compute, while a single detected forgery slashes the bond, so Sybil scale becomes expensive and unprofitable.
